title: File:Sa Pa Lake 1.jpg
claims: The photograph shows Sa Pa Lake in the centre of Sa Pa, with a calm reflective surface in the foreground, a low lakeside road and railing, closely packed town buildings behind it and the Hoang Lien Son ridge under cloud above the rooftops; it is a town-centre view, not the Sapa Square start line, a race arch, aid station, course marking or race-day crowd.

Commons titles the file Sa Pa Lake 1.jpg and the description reads 'View of the Sa Pa Lake'; the route page uses it only as the town setting for the 2026 VMM 100km start, not as proof of the exact start line or of race-day conditions.

The author is Christophe95; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2018-08-09 at 17:14:37; the original is 5,184 x 3,888 pixels and 5,455,110 bytes; the file page gives a camera location of 22.337815 N, 103.846696 E.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 copy of 138,380 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Christophe95, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
